common.comingSoonBody: This part of KaziForce is still being built. It will be ready soon.

offline.message: You are offline. New alerts will appear when you are back online.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.allRead: You have read all your alerts.
alerts.notImportantDone: Marked as not important. We will show you fewer alerts like it.

groups.urgent: Act now. These can expire soon.
groups.low: No rush. We also send these in your daily summary email.

empty.allBody: When something needs your attention, it will show up here.
empty.filteredBody: No alerts match this choice. Choose "All" to see everything.

error.title: We could not load your alerts
error.body: Check your internet connection, then try again.

detail.notImportantHelp: We will show you fewer alerts like this one.
detail.choose: Choose an alert on the left to see it here.

language.label: Language
language.help: The language used in the app and in your messages.

textSize.label: Text size
textSize.help: Large makes all text and buttons bigger.

reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.help: Turns off movement and animation on the screen.

errors.notFoundBody: The link may be old or mistyped.
errors.genericBody: Please reload the page. If it keeps happening, try again later.

login.title: Log in
login.notReady: Logging in is not ready yet. For now, choose which side of KaziForce you want to see.
login.workerHelp: See job alerts, applications and messages.
login.businessHelp: See new applicants, replies and your jobs.

landing.title: Job alerts that reach you in time

hero.title: Never miss a job that is right for you
hero.body: KaziForce sends urgent job alerts straight to your WhatsApp or SMS, and keeps everything else calm and tidy.

how.title: How KaziForce alerts work
how.checkBody: Fake jobs and messages asking you to send money are stopped before they reach you.
how.sortBody: Each alert is marked Urgent, Important or For later, so you know what to do first.
how.sendTitle: We send it where you look
how.sendBody: Urgent alerts go to WhatsApp or SMS. If you miss one, we try your next choice.

levels.title: Three levels, easy to tell apart
levels.body: Every alert shows a colour, a picture and a word, so you never have to guess.
levels.urgent: Act now: jobs that close soon, or a job offer you received.
levels.medium: Worth a look today: messages and updates on your applications.
levels.low: No rush: tips and news. We also send these in one daily email.

control.title: You are in control
control.channels: Choose what comes first: WhatsApp, SMS or email.
control.quiet: Quiet hours: we will not disturb you at night, except for urgent job offers.
control.notImportant: Tap "Not important to me" to see fewer alerts like it.
control.language: Use KaziForce in English or Kiswahili.

employers.title: For employers
employers.body: Post a job and the right workers hear about it in minutes. You can see when each worker received your message.

footer.project: A student project at Strathmore University, Nairobi.
footer.privacy: WhatsApp and SMS alerts never include your personal details.

uiKit.title: Component gallery
uiKit.intro: Every building block of the KaziForce interface, in one place.
uiKit.nameHelp: As it appears on your ID.
uiKit.phoneHelp: We send a code to this number.
uiKit.phoneError: Enter a Kenyan number starting with 07 or 01, for example 0712 345 678.
uiKit.switchHelp: One email each morning with the alerts marked "For later".
uiKit.dialogBody: We will not send alerts between 9pm and 7am, except urgent job offers.
